title: Do LLM agents behave like spins? Response functions, live networks and amplification near tipping points (code, data and replication package)
description: Code, committed results, pre-registrations and the replication package for the study. make replicate-fast (about 55 min on 4 cores) and make replicate (about 37 h; 16 h without the Amendment 4 null distribution) reproduce every analysis and figure from the cached model responses, with no API keys and no GPU, and print a pass/fail table per claim. The response cache, pod outputs and simulation units are in the Hugging Face dataset RandallSPQR/social-phase-transitions-data (CC BY 4.0). Code: Apache-2.0. See replication/README.md.
notes: Pre-registration provenance: replication/provenance/PREREG_PROVENANCE.md ties every pre-registration document to its git commit and to GitHub's server-side push log. The five OpenAI proofs that motivated the study are cited by title and not redistributed.
